rule.ce_metadata: CE tag metadata is never dropped by these entries; only the MEDIA payload is affected.
rule.exclusion_semantics: a bitmap MEDIA payload is dropped in a profile only when every consumer reference of that bitmap (bitmap_consumers plus typed tag_index references joined through the CTAG) is covered by a pinned exclusion row for its own role (per-reference match, per-profile kind), via hcu_profile_consumer_exclusions.decide_profile. Any pixel-path reference, selected or model/CBSP-covered material, undecided role or zero references keep it. Each row's counts are the distinct dropped 2D images in that profile that one of its rows covers; dropped_images holds the distinct dropped total per profile.
rule.reader: a real PS2 reader consumes the MEDIA pixels: a reader's pixel path must reach GS upload through non-stub code. Dereferencing tag fields (bounds, counts, sequence metadata), a passthrough that returns its argument, a port function that only discards its arguments or returns FALSE/0/NULL, or a count-only sprite accumulator (NON_GS_SINKS) keeps metadata alive but does NOT keep media alive. Absent functions are not readers.
rule.runtime_admission: not an input; reported only as totals.runtime_admitted_bitm_bindings
rule.user_decision: CONSUMER RULE = "a data class is live if a real (non-stub) PS2 reader for it is linked in the CURRENT parent renderer build or the CURRENT HCU closure. Its hookup into the HCU frame is a C3 carry-over (like the running-frame binding). Classes with no PS2 reader anywhere are dropped from the profiles." Runtime admission is NOT an input (it is a later gate); it is reported only as a separate field.
